content: Decision: rate-limit the webhook consumer with a token bucket rather than a fixed window, because bursts at the top of the minute starved single-tenant keys; the sliding-window and queue-first designs were rejected for that reason.
Decision: store user avatars on disk under /srv/avatars with content-hash names instead of S3 — the deployment has no outbound S3 access, and a bucket design was ruled out by that network policy.

Decision: the importer reads CSVs with a streaming parser, not pandas, because files up to 2 GB exhaust the container's memory when loaded whole; chunked DataFrame loading was tried and dropped for the same reason.
Decision: auth tokens live in httpOnly cookies rather than localStorage, to keep them out of reach of injected scripts; the header-storage variant was rejected after the XSS audit.
Decision: the nightly job runs at 03:40 UTC, not midnight, because the upstream export finishes at 03:30 and a midnight run always ingested yesterday's file twice.
Decision: this deployment pins Postgres 16 because pg_textsearch ships as a shared library built for that major; version 15 was ruled out when the preload failed on it.
Decision: the public API is versioned under /v2 only; /v1 was rejected because its response envelope cannot express per-namespace errors without breaking existing clients.

Decision: the migration runs one transaction per batch rather than one for the whole file, because a failure then costs one batch of retries instead of a full re-run; the whole-file transaction was ruled out after a failed run cost four hours.
The team's convention is ruff with line length 100; black and isort stay out of this repo by choice.
The client requires that all customer data stay in the eu-central-1 region; US regions are out by policy.
Deployment must run on the air-gapped cluster: no image pulls from Docker Hub at runtime, everything is vendored.
The user prefers errors reported as RFC 7807 problem+json bodies, not ad-hoc JSON shapes.
Company policy: every service exposes /healthz returning 200 without auth, or it does not pass the platform review.
The reviewer requires migration scripts to be reversible before merge; an irreversible one needs a stated exception.
The CI runner has only 2 CPU cores, so pytest-xdist with more than two workers slows the suite down.
The staging database is re-seeded every night at 02:00 UTC, so row counts cached from staging are stale by morning.
Docker on this machine denies binding ports below 1024, so the local stack maps the API to 18010.
The corporate proxy rewrites TLS certificates, so pip only works against the internal index at pypi.internal.corp.
Prod Postgres runs with max_connections=40; opening more than a handful of parallel pool connections starves the worker.
Outbound webhooks from this network are throttled to about 10 requests per second by the gateway; bursts beyond that come back 429.
Lesson: the OAuth flow silently failed because the redirect URI had a trailing slash the provider treats as a distinct URI; register and compare redirect URIs normalized.
Reproduced bug: a dimension-mismatched halfvec embedding raises no error but returns garbage similarity; the fix is asserting the dimension before insert.
Lesson: the parser choked on CSVs with a UTF-8 BOM; open with encoding utf-8-sig, not utf-8.
The race between cache write and invalidation corrupted reads under load; the fix invalidates after commit, not before — invalidating before commit reintroduces stale reads on retry.
Lesson: the webhook retries are at-least-once, so every handler must be idempotent; deduplication by event id fixed the double-charged invoices.
The memory leak under gunicorn came from module-level httpx clients sharing a closed event loop; creating the client inside the worker's lifespan fixed it.
Batching embeddings through a thread pool failed — the endpoint serves one request per connection and the pool serialized anyway; the async client with gather is what actually works.
Relying on pg_trgm for the keyword lane lost short Korean queries; the pg_textsearch path is what the eval now measures.
Serving table aggregates from the Card summary answered with stale numbers; only doc_rows through SQL returns current results.
Auto-merging duplicate notes by cosine alone merged distinct facts; deduplication stays a curated decision based on list_memory_duplicates output.

src/importer/stream.py opens a CSV row iterator and yields one dict per row.
The rate_limiter.py module defines a token bucket with a per-key lock.
utils/time.py has helpers to parse ISO 8601 timestamps and coerce them to UTC.
conftest.py starts a throwaway Postgres container for integration tests and removes it at session end.
The AvatarStore class writes files under /srv/avatars and returns the content hash as the name.
